The sun prostrates beneath the Throne and asks leave to rise, until told to rise in the west; the sun and moon will be folded up on Resurrection Day.
The Prophet tells Abu Dharr the sun goes and prostrates beneath Allah's Throne, the meaning of verse 36.38 on the sun running its fixed course.
At night in Maimuna's house the Prophet rose, looked at the sky and recited that the creation of heavens and earth and the alternation of night and day hold signs.
The Prophet said the sun asks permission to prostrate, and one day will be told to return and rise in the west; he recited the verse on its course.
Asked about the verse on the sun running its fixed course, the Prophet said its fixed course is beneath Allah's Throne.
